title: Discover free quotas, credit and reset windows conservatively
goal: Normalize provider-supported balance, remaining request/token limits, free allowances, reset windows and Retry-After from official metadata and actual responses. Represent unknown separately from zero and unlimited; do not invent balance APIs or assume a successful model listing proves inference credit. Support multiple keys per vendor with opaque credential IDs. No automatic purchase, top-up or paid probe; bounded probes require existing consent and budget. Wire observations into eligibility; hermetic fixtures cover free-only, paid-only, mixed tiers, missing/stale headers, clock skew and account-shared quotas. Implement tests named cloud_quota_inventory_*; acceptance must execute at least one test.
